para_examples.original: I'm planning to hold a premium price this round, since quality and healthy margins matter more to me than chasing volume. I'd expect a stable market where everyone prices sensibly.
para_examples.delivered: I intend to keep a high price this round, because quality and solid margins are more important to me than pursuing sales volume. I'm counting on a steady market in which every participant sets prices reasonably.
